screens.prompt: Build humble forms from suitable verb stems.

table.caption: お + ます stem + する

cells: 預かります → 預かり
お荷物をお預かりします。
I will look after your luggage.
そのご依頼はお断りします。

before.text: For suitable verbs, use お + the ます stem + する to humbly describe your own action toward another person. 預かります supplies 預かり, not 預かります. This pattern is not available for every verb.
I will look after your luggage. I must decline that request.

screens.prompt: Borrow humbly: insert three characters before the supplied します.

after.text: お借りします。
I will borrow it.

借りる means to borrow; 貸す means to lend. お借りする humbly describes the speaker borrowing something belonging to the listener. てもいいですか asks permission; てもらえますか asks someone else to do a favour. 借ります supplies 借り; お is the prefix.
